standard_prerequisites.name: An ideal lies in the Jacobson radical if and only if every element of 1 + I is a unit

standard_prerequisites.name: Filtered colimits: an element of a filtered colimit is the image of an element of some stage, and the same for a finite system of elements and relations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: used at proof lines 2893-2910 to descend f, the factorisation and the Bezout relation to one index j
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the mechanism that reduces the verification to a single henselian pair.

core_obligations: Show that I is contained in the Jacobson radical of A: lift an element u of 1 + I to some A_j, use that u_j is a unit there because I_j lies in the radical, and conclude (proof lines 2893-2899).
Descend a monic polynomial f over A together with a factorisation fbar = g_0 h_0 and a Bezout relation to a single index j (proof lines 2901-2910).
Apply the henselian property at that stage to lift the factorisation and map it back to A (proof lines 2910-2916).
Conclude that (A, I) is a henselian pair (proof line 2916).
proof_roadmap: Verify the radical condition by lifting elements of 1 + I to a stage (proof lines 2893-2899).
Descend the polynomial, the factorisation and the Bezout relation to one stage (proof lines 2901-2910).
Lift the factorisation at that stage and conclude (proof lines 2910-2917).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a filtered colimit of henselian pairs is again henselian, and the proof is a 25-line argument with two independent halves. For the radical condition it lifts an element of 1 + I to some stage and uses that the stage ideal lies in the Jacobson radical; for the lifting of factorisations it uses that both the ring and its quotient are filtered colimits to descend a monic polynomial together with a factorisation and a Bezout relation to a single stage, lifts the factorisation there by the henselian hypothesis, and maps back up. The descent to one stage is the step with content, since two different stages may be involved before the argument begins.
